question.text: What percentage of firm finance arrangements (excluding IPO proceeds and internal accruals) must be in place before filing the offer document under Regulation 7?

explanation.text: The Logic: Firm arrangements of finance through verifiable means must cover at least 75% of the stated means of finance for a specific project, excluding the amount proposed to be raised through the public issue and existing identifiable internal accruals. The Trap: 100% would imply no scope for the proposed issue proceeds or internal accruals to fund the project; the 50% and 60% options are plausible-sounding distractors that do not match Regulation 7. Note: The 75% test is applied to the project's stated means of finance after excluding the public issue amount and identifiable internal accruals.
